comment: Test A of docs/pedal-research/animated-covers.md: does the pedal redraw an effect's screen on its own? Knob 1 and 2 show the DSP cycle counter (TSCL) as their value text, read in the value-text callbacks. Audio passes through. No memory writes, no fardata.

params.name: Slow
params.comment: Shows (TSCL >> 24) as 2 hex digits: ticks ~18x/s at ~300 MHz, wraps ~every 14 s.

params.name: Fast
params.comment: Shows (TSCL >> 12) & 0xFFF as 3 hex digits: different on every call.
